title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file
description: patch_file failed to apply diff to 'src/moeb/src/tools/tool_executor_tests.rs': error applying hunk #1. The diff context lines did not match the file content. The intended change was subsequently applied successfully via write_file.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file failed and whether the intended operation completed. If a file write was not applied, a write_file fallback or retry is required before the next run succeeds.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash to execute `cargo test` to verify tests pass after renaming the test function. No moeb shell-execution tool exists for running arbitrary shell commands.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb shell-execution tool covering running arbitrary shell commands (e.g. cargo test, cargo build --release).
